name: Bang Bang
headline: Visionary Founder of Bang Bang NYC & Photorealistic Master
bio: Keith 'Bang Bang' McCurdy transformed the tattoo industry from gritty underground shops into high-fashion art institutions. His SoHo flagship studio hosts the world's most elite roster of realist artists. Known for mind-bending photographic fidelity and invisible needlework, Bang Bang has tattooed global icons from Rihanna to LeBron James.
awards: Author of My Life in Ink
Architectural Digest Studio of the Decade
